adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is set to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists (`destinationCalendar: ... : null`). Later, for collective team events, the code attempts `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`, which becomes a no-op if `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`. Since `teamDestinationCalendars` is populated from co-host users (`users.slice(1)`) who may have `user.destinationCalendar`, this means co-host destination calendars can be silently dropped exactly when the organizer/event type has no destination calendar.
